memory_candidates.content: When writing docs/ prose about paths or modules that will exist only after a future refactor phase, write them relative to the library root (e.g. `Metalogic/Expressiveness/`, `Metalogic.Expressiveness.Kamp`) so the C5 (dotted `FormalSystem.*`) and C12 (slash `FormalSystem/`, `Tests/`, `Logos/`, `Bimodal/`) resolvers never see an unresolvable name; state the convention once at the top of the document. `Logos/ProofChecker` written with a slash trips C12's pre-merge-root pattern.

Parse only a Lean file's leading `import` block (after the copyright comment, stopping at the first non-import command) when building an import graph: a naive `grep '^import'` also matches usage examples inside module docstrings and produced a false self-cycle on the root aggregator; nine live files differ between the two readings. scripts/lib/import_graph.py is the shared implementation.

reflection.what_worked: Running the measurement script before writing any prose, and re-running it after, meant every count in the documents was copied from output rather than from the report; the four discrepancies were found by the script, not by a reader.
reflection.what_was_hard: Keeping docs/ prose inside the gates: C12's Logos/ pre-merge pattern, C5's dotted-name resolver and C13's link resolver each constrain how a not-yet-existing path can be written, which is why the phase order was flipped to write the ADRs before the document that links them.
reflection.what_was_missed: The first namespace audit compared against the file's module rather than the directory module and reported 35/430 instead of the report's 279/187; the report's Appendix had stated the directory-based definition and should have been followed from the start.
reflection.successes: Four phases closed and committed with zero diffs under FormalSystem/ and Tests/, a green full harness with build, exactly one Metalogic cycle, and a --check gate that turns the programme's largest move into a measured precondition.
